name: Sequencing batch reactor (SBR)
principle: A fill-and-draw activated sludge variant: all treatment phases run sequentially in one basin per cycle (fill, react, settle, decant, idle), eliminating secondary clarifiers and RAS pumping; licensor equipment (Aqua-Aerobic decanters, Veolia configurations) supplies the decanter and cycle control.

costs.metric: operation and maintenance cost, sequencing batch reactor
costs.basis: EPA fact sheet: operation and maintenance costs are site specific and may range from USD 800 to USD 2,000 per million gallons treated. Document dated September 1999 and states no dollar year, so the document year is recorded.

source.note: US EPA, Wastewater Technology Fact Sheet: Sequencing Batch Reactors, EPA 832-F-99-073, September 1999, COSTS section
